name: Yard Crashers
description: Professional landscaper Chris Lambton and the Yard Crashers crew turn ordinary backyards into striking spaces with novel takes on decks, patios, fire pits, water features, landscaping, hardscaping and more

videos.title: Backyard Cabana
videos.overview: This backyard is transformed into the ultimate bachelor pad complete with all the glitz and glamour of a Vegas retreat including a mahogany stained bamboo cabana! A black slate fire pit provides a social gathering space and is topped off with bright blue fireplace glass to really put it over the top. A soothing water feature with a bamboo fountain completes the look of this backyard oasis and gives the feel of poolside Vegas luxury!

videos.title: Poker Patio
videos.overview: A backyard goes from dog disaster to poker haven with the addition of a simple flagstone patio, brand new sod and a deck remodel.

videos.title: Backyard Bocci
videos.overview: This yard turns from dead veggie garden and an unused side yard, to a sophisticated slate patio and backyard bocce ball court! See how a dead patch of lawn becomes a family fun entertainment area. Also, there's no need to go out and buy an outdoor sofa when you can make one!

videos.title: Pool Patio
videos.overview: This outdated pink pool deck just won't cut it for these new homeowners who have big plans to entertain in their brand new backyard! See how this backyard's cracked putrid pink pool patio goes gets a smooth facelift. And, a hot pool deck gets some cool shade with a redwood shade structure. Plus, a useless bark strip gets nixed and replaced with poolside plants and some outdoor lighting for night swims!

videos.title: Rock Yard
videos.overview: This backyard turns from a muddy swamp and one big electrical nightmare to a rockin' patio entertainment hub. See how a smooth stained concrete pad replaces an ugly paver-patio. Also, some dangerous old misters hanging from electrical wires find their way to the dump and cooler misting fans take their place. Creative fence panels and an outdoor fireplace complete the look and make this backyard fit for some interesting homeowners.

videos.title: Outdoor Theater
videos.overview: One family's wasted space is transformed into the ultimate outdoor theater with a unique staircase entrance, redwood seating and an inflatable projector screen!

videos.title: Floating Deck
videos.overview: Talk about a blank slate. This backyard has nothing going for it. An ugly stucco wall, dead grass and plants and that's just about it. See how this backyard transforms from dead to lively as a floating deck takes center stage. Also, unusual mulches! Blue glass and rubber bark are key components to this makeover. A sun sail and vibrant sod take this yard to a new level.

videos.title: Side Yard Swing
videos.overview: This backyard turns from boring backyard to the ultimate hang out spot as an unused side yard gets a custom arbor swing and colorful sandbox for family fun! Also, a small paver walkway gets one major extension; a patio! Just some rock, sand and new pavers and this backyard has a space to entertain. One boulder bench and some new sod complete the look and gets this young family playing outside!

videos.title: Front Door Facelift
videos.overview: A neglected front yard gets an upgrade with all new planter beds, a formal boxwood hedge and decorative sunken containers.

videos.title: Backyard Bar
videos.overview: An old brick barbeque becomes a stylish bar with stacked stone seating and a bordered gravel patio.

videos.title: Draining Patio
videos.overview: It's a whole lot of soggy sod. This young married couple has a great backyard but it's one giant mess when it rains. Plus, they live on the bottom of a slope, so their neighbors water pools in their yard, giving this backyard zero space to hang out. The homeowners thought they needed to build a simple French drain, but they need something better! See how some one wet lawn transforms into a usable draining patio.

videos.title: Mediterranean Patio
videos.overview: It's one boring side-yard with loads of rock and a giant 100- year old olive tree. These homeowners had aspirations of creating a Tuscan setting but couldn't pull it off themselves. See how this backyard turns from a rock pile to an Italian garden with a copper water wall, roman stamped concrete and one hot fire table.

videos.title: Pizza Patio
videos.overview: A blank slate backyard becomes a gourmet kitchen with a wood-fire oven and granite-tiled island, set on top of a natural flagstone patio.

videos.title: Bamboo Jungle
videos.overview: This backyard gets an exotic makeover as it's transformed into a bamboo jungle! An old chain link fence and wrought iron cabana are completely remodeled with bamboo fencing and green wood. A unique, bamboo water feature serves as a stunning centerpiece for the yard and at six feet high, the sound of water completely drowns out the freeway noise!

videos.title: Galvanized Gazebo
videos.overview: This couple has tons of space in their backyard but no reason to spend time in it. This backyard goes from boring lawn to the ultimate hang out as a sweet galvanized gazebo fills the wasted space. Also, a few metal tables and comfortable lounge seating make this gazebo anything but ordinary. A new walkway, unique light posts and one colorful glass chandelier complete the look and gets this couple chillin' in their backyard.

videos.title: Small-Space Concrete
videos.overview: This tiny yard gets a massive upgrade as it's transformed into a hip, urban retreat with clean lines and a very modern design. The existing concrete pad is stained to infuse color into the yard and poured concrete rectangles with inlaid tile extend the patio space. To top it off, a unique trellis adds vibrant pops of color with high-tech tiles unlike any you've seen before!

videos.title: Rustic Country Patio
videos.overview: It's a yard like no other- sheep, rams and about two hundred acres. See how this interesting yard transforms from a hodgepodge yard to a backyard destination. An uneven flagstone patio gets replaced by a large decomposed granite patio, a few interesting window walls to maintain the view but block the wind and a one of a kind water feature for a one of a kind backyard!

videos.title: Backyard Brewery
videos.overview: This home brewer's mess of a yard is quickly transformed into the ultimate backyard brewery. A custom steel wrap-around bar with a dual tap beer tower serves as the centerpiece, accented by barstools made from recycled kegs! The party space extends out past the bar to a brick "fryer" pit and a keg table topped with beer caps!

videos.title: Hot-Tub Hub
videos.overview: This new house has a backyard that looks like it's got everything going right- a hot tub, brand new outdoor kitchen, even a shade structure! But it's ultra boring! See how this yard becomes a hot tub entertainment hub- complete with a colorful stamped concrete pathway, inviting U-shaped vertical seating walls with a pop of unique colored material, slate mosaic walls and a one of a kind shade structure make this makeover memorable.

videos.title: Sleepy Creek Bed
videos.overview: This yard is transformed from a barren wasteland of dead grass to a relaxing, woodsy retreat. A dry creek meanders through, creating separate rooms connected by a bridge with a decorative arbor top. Cobble stone patios are placed on both sides along with hammocks and a bubbling, fogging fountain!

videos.title: Gravel Table
videos.overview: This bachelor is one happy homeowner but he's got a neglected landscape that needs some serious help. In just two days, this backyard transforms into the ultimate bachelor pad- complete with a resourceful gravel table, a sweet sail shade, lush sod, innovative ice chests and one luxurious hot tub- making this once pitiful backyard a colorful oasis.

videos.title: Barbecue Island
videos.overview: A small, odd shaped yard is transformed into a griller's paradise with the addition of a deluxe barbeque island with built-in seating. Overhead, a redwood arbor with stripes of multi-colored shade cloth adds function and an element of design. Surrounding the patio a plank walkway and mow-free grass expand the usable entertaining space.

videos.title: Barn Deck
videos.overview: What was once a dead lawn, overgrown plants, unused kids toys and outdated backyard accessories gets a facelift. . With a sweet design and hard work, this backyard comes to life as a one hundred year old barn deck is set into place, a concrete chic fire feature and vibrant plants are incorporated into the mix.

videos.title: Mosaic Patio
videos.overview: A mixed-media patio expands the usable space in this tiny yard and adds artistic flare. Its unique design is composed of several different concrete pavers mixed in with natural flagstone. In the middle of the patio, an "island" is built to showcase a pebble mosaic water feature that anyone can build!

videos.title: Backyard Living Room
videos.overview: With a small house, this homeowner wants to expand the living space into her backyard. This landscape goes from unused lawn space to large paver patio framed by colorful hanging antique windows and a bright door. Also, some hardwood deck planks are put together to build some deep rectangular bench seating. Some new plants, hanging party lights and a tree stump turned into a slick coffee table and this couple gets the ultimate outdoor room.

videos.title: Ultimate French Drain
videos.overview: A serious drainage problem is solved underground with a French drain that's disguised on top by plants and a dry creek bed. Creative, recycled seating is placed throughout the yard and a massive daybed caps off the end of the creek. Made of redwood and metal with huge outdoor cushions, this daybed provides comfortable lounging for six or more.

videos.title: Outdoor Fireplace
videos.overview: A matchbook sized backyard of mud and beige walls is transformed into a colorful urban oasis with a custom stucco fireplace, modern horizontal fence panels and an instant natural slate patio.

videos.title: Outdoor Shower
videos.overview: It's a great backyard but it isn't making a statement. But that all changes in two days! This backyard becomes entertainment central, complete with a colorful fire table and a one-of-a-kind outdoor shower that sits right on top of a custom curved deck. Plus, Ahmed takes this makeover one step further with a brand-new fence that has it's own beautiful stone pergola gate!

videos.title: Island Waterfall
videos.overview: This small yard is transformed into an island oasis with the addition of a beachy concrete overlay, a unique tiki bar and a four-foot waterfall.

videos.title: Colorful Steel Arbor
videos.overview: A decrepit backyard with a broken arbor, old deck and cracked concrete gets a modern face lift. In just two days, a steel arbor with colorful retractable shade panels, industrial water feature, milled cedar benches and framed patio are set in place and bring new life to this backyard!

videos.title: Modern Putting Green
videos.overview: His and hers entertaining spaces are added to this yard in the form of a slate patio with a custom concrete table and a putting green that blends in with the landscape.

videos.title: Modern Fire Wall
videos.overview: This couple is bored with their yard of grass and over grown trees! See how a modern fire wall, giant clusters of custom planters, a decomposed granite patio and slick seating area give these homeowners a place to entertain.

videos.title: Chess Board Patio
videos.overview: This yard becomes the ultimate entertaining space with the addition of a concrete and sod checkered patio with built-in benches and giant chess pieces.

videos.title: Pagoda Shed
videos.overview: A plain old backyard is taken to the next level! These homeowners get exactly what they asked for- a Japanese inspired yard! An old metal shed is replaced by a stylish pagoda style shed with one-of-a-kind sliding doors. Plus, this team takes it to the next level with a shade structure and floating deck that actually matches the shed! A few slate stepping stones, slick barbeque grill, lanterns and lush landscape complete the "crash."

videos.title: Tropical Pond Oasis
videos.overview: A waterfall is built coming out of a seat wall and leading into a fish pond to create a tropical oasis that's topped off with a cabana bar.

videos.title: Carribean Cabana
videos.overview: A backyard full of waist high weeds and bright hot sun is screaming for some help! In two full days this backyard is transformed into a Caribbean oasis. Two vibrant giant cabana peaks take center stage in this backyard, giving these homeowners some much needed shade. A "sandy" concrete patio becomes the new entertainment area. A rich tropical hardwood platform deck and matching walkway gives the yard some direction. Plus, Ahmad replaces the old dead weeds with some new sod. And, to top it off, a modern hammock and sweet fire feature make this yard feel like beach.

videos.title: Woodsy Spa Retreat
videos.overview: This plain yard becomes a woodland retreat with a lodge structure built over a hot tub, a wood deck and a cultured stone fireplace.

videos.title: Snack Shack
videos.overview: It's a disaster of a backyard! The garage is falling apart and the landscape is just plain ugly. With a whole lot of help, this backyard gets a major facelift. The old plywood garage is transformed into the ultimate snack shack! See how some rock veneer, a solid redwood counter top, a new door and a few beer taps give these two young single homeowners a place to entertain! Plus, you can't have a snack shack without a sports court! Top it off with a giant paver patio, custom light fixtures and some unique cocktail tables and these guys are sitting pretty in their new digs.

videos.title: Disney Epcot
videos.overview: Ahmed gives the Disney folks a hand, behind the scenes, on this massive makeover. Plus he transforms his very own corner, along with our homeowner, into a Disney Yard Crash, complete with a sitting garden Ahmed style!

videos.title: Double Grill Island
videos.overview: This bare yard is transformed into a griller's paradise with the addition of a barbeque island with a built-in grill and smoker. This island is covered in reclaimed Chicago Common brick veneer and topped with concrete countertops that include a bar top for entertaining. The surrounding yard is also transformed with a cedar deck remodel, privacy plantings and a bluestone and gravel patio.

videos.title: Cobble Driveway Patio
videos.overview: Yard Crashers is taking it on the road and crashing Chicago. Host and licensed landscape contractor Ahmed Hassan finds homeowners with a giant backyard of grass, a cracked driveway and decrepit screened in porch that he's ready to transform. In just two days, the backyard is torn down and built back up with a giant antique cobble driveway patio that leads to a revived screened in porch complete with indestructible screens and one giant remote control screen the opens up into the backyard. Plus, they introduce an old piece for a new fire pit by using an antique sugar kettle shipped in from Louisiana. They build up beautiful stone around the sugar kettle and it's ready for the fire. A brand new barbeque, new grass and two truckloads of plants make this yard complete.

videos.title: A River Runs Through It
videos.overview: This crash muscles its way through the storm of the century to turn a neglected backyard with an abandoned water feature into a rustic mountain retreat for this outdoor loving couple. Ahmed and crew take the best parts of the homeowners' "river in progress" and transform it into a giant waterfall spilling into a running-water river bed winding around the yard and emptying into a new fire feature. Next, efforts are turned toward rehab'ing an existing patio by adding flagstone to increase the "hang out" space. The extra space creates a home for their beloved grill as part of a new outdoor kitchen featuring chunky leathered granite counters.

videos.title: Perogla Seat Wall
videos.overview: A disastrous backyard gets a major facelift. What was once a rotten retaining wall, plain dirt and shabby fence becomes a classy outdoor hangout. In two days, this backyard totally transforms as a pergola seat wall, moss rock water feature and tile patio take center stage. Plus, the homeowners have a ton of shade preventing grass from growing so host and licensed landscape contractor Ahmed Hassan uses recycled rubber mulch to create a soft surface.

videos.title: Industrial Metal Bar
videos.overview: An engineer's yard turns into an industrial paradise with a custom metal bar at the centerpiece with a little help from host and licensed landscape contractor Ahmed Hassan. Different types of metal are mixed to create a unique bar structure with rustic concrete counters and a steel awning overhead. A fire/water feature functions as another social gathering area and a cedar hot tub tucked into the landscaping creates a private oasis for two.

videos.title: Vegas Water Table
videos.overview: Yard Crashers is hitting up Las Vegas and crashing a desert backyard. Host and licensed landscape contractor Ahmed Hassan finds homeowners who can't get anything to grow in their yard, in fact, it's just dirt. In just two days, this backyard transforms from hot desert wasteland to a luxurious outdoor room complete with a custom barbeque island water table, a concrete fire feature, lush synthetic turf grass topped off with some flashy Vegas lights.

videos.title: Waterfall Grill
videos.overview: It's Yard Crashers largest yard yet. This huge yard goes from a bare and broken down blank slate to a pristine park. A soccer field gives the kids a place to play while a beautiful paver patio with shade structure above creates a hangout hub for adults. Host and licensed landscape contractor Ahmed Hassan creates a patio area which sports a one of a kind "aqua grill" with a water feature on one side and a BBQ on the other. A fire pit and matching benches add another entertaining area for the entire family to enjoy.

videos.title: Urban Spa Deck
videos.overview: An unwelcoming spa overlooking a cluttered carport and yellowing lawn gets amped up with a yin-yang makeover. A 600 square foot composite deck mimicking tropical hardwood is built around the hot tub to extend the "hang-ability" factor. Host and licensed landscape contractor Ahmed Hassan enhances the view with a hip sheet metal wall which is welded with angular pieces of scrap metal. In the yard, an oversized octagon-shaped fire pit is plunked in the middle of a tranquil garden to give this backyard a chic yet serene style.

videos.title: Eco-Friendly Outdoor Kitchen
videos.overview: This yard is kicked up for some serious entertaining with a monster outdoor kitchen that includes a matching fire table for serving guests..

videos.title: Water Fire Wall
videos.overview: Ahmed is headed to Tampa, FL, to change one couple's yard from an ugly, blank slate to an entertaining paradise.

videos.title: Onyx Water Bar
videos.overview: A family of five gets a complete yard makeover that turns a weed-filled blank space into an entertainer's paradise with a flashy outdoor kitchen that includes a grill and kegerator.

videos.title: Potting Shed Bar
videos.overview: Professional caterers get a backyard makeover that turns their blank slate into a food-producing wonderland with a very unique entertainment hub.

videos.title: Contemporary Spool Oasis
videos.overview: This empty, weed-filled backyard becomes an oasis with the addition of a "spool" -- a spa-pool combo that's surrounded with rock walls and waterfalls.

videos.title: Reclaimed Party Pad
videos.overview: This backyard is tricked out with reclaimed elements in every corner from the barn wood deck and antique Chicago street pavers to the "urbanite" fire pit made from their old concrete patio.

videos.title: A Slammin' Stainless Hot Tub
videos.overview: A young couple who has a rather drab backyard get an outdoor fantasy which starts with a mosaic inspired by the homeowner's artwork, a flaming water feature, beautiful paver patio and a huge stainless steel patio.

videos.title: Woodland Garden Getaway
videos.overview: A young couple who loves to entertain gets a jungle of a backyard cleared out and turned into a twinkling woodland garden getaway.

videos.title: Rocking Atlanta
videos.overview: A young Atlanta couple has a run-down backyard that has become a recycled mess. Ahmed and his team build an amazing mountain retreat, complete with a recycled picnic table, fireplace/cook stove and tons of beautiful plants.

videos.title: Moroccan Arbor Lounge
videos.overview: This ignored and overgrown yard is transformed into a Moroccan-inspired hangout with bamboo plank walkways, a bamboo arbor, mosaic tile fireplace and lounge seating.

videos.title: Triple Decker
videos.overview: A growing family gets a splash of fun in their backyard with three new decks: a pool deck with a silky interior pool surface, a kid-friendly wet deck with water cannons and a raised composite deck with shade sail.

videos.title: Swim Up Margarita Bar
videos.overview: A bartender gets the ultimate bachelor pad with a margarita bar with a built-in TV. The pool is refinished in black along the new Caribbean deck and a "dock" is built to create another entertaining area along the edge of the pool.

videos.title: Bali Escape
videos.overview: A young couple who has let their backyard get the best of them gets a complete makeover with a "Bali" theme complete with a meditation deck, rain feature, poured-concrete patio and tons of new landscaping.

videos.title: Backyard Balcony
videos.overview: A sizable backyard that's become a storage space for a bachelor's toys and tools soars to new heights with a second-floor door and balcony, mature trees and a regulation horseshoe pit.

videos.title: Yard with a View
videos.overview: A backyard next to a creek is completely transformed into a cozy spot to enjoy a hot tub, fire pit, flagstone patio and redwood swing set. An opening cut into the newly built fence creates a yard with a view.

videos.title: Colonial Hillside Redo
videos.overview: A hillside renovation is complete with a swing that sweeps out over a knot garden, a 10-foot-long brick fountain built into a retaining wall and a three-tiered pergola and patio extension that features art and a drop-in barbecue.

videos.title: Light-Up Onyx Bar
videos.overview: This Las Vegas yard is transformed into party central with the addition of a massive fireplace wall and an L-shaped bar with an onyx countertop that lights up.

videos.title: Vegas Splash Pad
videos.overview: A once ordinary backyard in the desert is completely transformed into a cool outdoor hot spot complete with a modern splash pad for both kids and adults, plus a surprise outdoor kitchen.

videos.title: Rose Parade
videos.overview: The Rose Queen herself delivers the plans that transform a boring, neglected Pasadena backyard into a space fit for royalty.

videos.title: Creek Bed Party Deck
videos.overview: A newly engaged couple with a boring, uninviting backyard sees their space transformed into a party place for friends and family.

videos.title: Modern Recycled Retreat
videos.overview: Air Force Sergeant Ann Oluwadare commands the troops to turn her junk-filled backyard into a modern hangout using recycled materials and sleek metal accents.

videos.title: Backyard Boulder Bash
videos.overview: An Atlanta couple has a backyard that's lacking any direction or creativity. There's tons of room for improvement, but with a dated patio and a couple of hillsides causing drainage problems, they just don't know where to start.

videos.title: Floating Decks
videos.overview: A newly single woman wants a place to entertain her friends while also having a place for relaxation. Ahmed's bringing in a cool water feature, a fire pit, two redwood floating decks and some custom-made shoji panels.

videos.title: Modern Backyard Design
videos.overview: Yard Crashers is crashing Atlanta, and just in time! This newly engaged couple needs help. They're overwhelmed by their oddly shaped hillside backyard and are more than ready to trade in their overgrown trees for a modern design.

videos.title: Mexican Party Backyard
videos.overview: With their Mexican heritage, these homeowners want a place to entertain while reflecting their culture's sense of fun and family. A new pergola, raised vegetable beds, new deck and fencing will surpass their expectations!

videos.title: Artistic Retreat
videos.overview: Ahmed and his crew are turning a small, boring yard into an artistic retreat for a Sacramento couple. And how does Ahmed top off this crash? With a gigantic orange tree lit from below and throughout with LED lights.

videos.title: Private Brick Patio Paradise
videos.overview: A young couple has a sparse backyard with no privacy and it's an old concrete slab with weeds. This blank slate is about to get the ultimate transformation and will become a hip entertaining space.

videos.title: Elegant Outdoor Living
videos.overview: Ahmed is crashing Chicago and he finds a couple who craves an outdoor living area that's perfect for all seasons. They want a place to eat, drink and relax -- even during those windy Chicago days.

videos.title: Modern Asian Living
videos.overview: Homeowners are desperate to have an Asian-inspired outdoor living area with a modern sense of style.

videos.title: Chef's Special
videos.overview: Things heat up for some newlywed chefs when their bland backyard turns savory with the installation of a fully-outfitted outdoor kitchen built from lightweight cabinets that are faced in stone veneer.

videos.title: Modern California Retreat
videos.overview: A couple wants a low-maintenance outdoor living space to host game night in place of their small, random, concrete-filled overgrown yard.

videos.title: Tudor to Thai
videos.overview: This young couple receives a Thai inspired backyard transformation including a brand new deck, a custom fire feature and a barbeque grill island. A floating meditation station is housed in a structure with a high-pitched rooftop not unlike those found in Thailand "stilt" houses. The floating nature of the build creates the above ground aspect in a stilt house as well as to create a space to be calm and meditate the stress away.

videos.title: Playground Paradise
videos.overview: New parents, Carri and Andrew, have a large backyard full of run down hardscape, weeds and no shelter from the sun. This blank slate gets turned into both an adult and kid-friendly paradise complete with pond, bar area with fire ring and pergola for adult fun and a kid playground with monkey bars and balance beam. The lush pond and large trees create a private and beautiful space, and unsightly areas of the yard get hidden behind a new fence and bar area, creating a playground paradise for adults and kids alike.

videos.title: Old World Pergola
videos.overview: This young couple receives a nature inspired old world makeover with a touch of modern. The topography of the yard has been transformed creating natural elevation changes and boulders have been added for seating on the new elevation. Fruit trees now surround the boulder seating area. Near the house, there's a leaf stamped pathway leading to a maple leaf stamped patio. On the patio stands a 16-foot high, hand huned pergola. The hand huning or planing of the wood is an old world style of decorating the structure in a one of a kind fashion. The structure is fastened together using the time tested techniques of mortise and tenon joinery. A touch of modern is added, as large planter pots become cushioned seats. Fruit trees now surround the boulder seating area. Near the house, there's a leaf stamped pathway leading to a maple leaf stamped patio.

videos.title: Outdoor Party Place
videos.overview: This newly engaged couple receives an outdoor party place with modern privacy panels, a fireplace seating area and a custom made bar.The Roman style columns are transformed and squared off. Privacy panels are built throughout the yard to match to square columns. Using lime green and cobalt blue colors on the columns and panels, a festive feel is created. This space is open and airy, yet private.

videos.title: Surfer Shangri-La
videos.overview: Surfing loving couple, Todd and Julie, turn their desolate and rock filled Las Vegas yard into a tropical paradise. With a surfboard garden with planted surfboards, a shell water feature and waves of colored glass, a shaded patio with pavers made from crushed seashells and a custom beach themed fire feature, the empty desert yard becomes a surfer's Shangri-la.

videos.title: Modern Tahoe
videos.overview: Homeowner Bodie and his girlfriend Kalli love their house that has been in Bodie's family for years, but unfortunately, the backyard hasn't been updated in all that time. An old-fashioned patio cover, uneven bricks and no privacy make this space unusable for them and their young son. Their love of Tahoe is the impetus behind the transformation which includes a faux river rock water feature, new entertaining area with pergola, updated patio cover and beams, and a unique piece of art made from a resident tree.

videos.title: Tampa Party Pad
videos.overview: A Tampa couple has no entertainment space, just grass on a sloping, uneven backyard. This backyard makeover consists of two thick paver patio areas. The top level has an outdoor bar made of polymer cabinets topped with granite and illuminated by different flashing colored LED lights. It also has a 40-inch TV built in. Adjacent to the bar are four grand water fountains underneath a decorative wood arbor. Then, step down on to a flagstone pathway leading to the lower level patio with a central fire feature adorned by three fire bowl columns.

videos.title: Infinity Edge Bar
videos.overview: Tampa homeowners Elizabeth & William Gourdine have a new house and a blank slate of a backyard with a lake view. The space goes from empty to entertaining with a unique bar complete with infinity edge water & fire features; a metal pergola; built in stone kitchen area and a custom TV cabinet.

videos.title: Mexican Resort Retreat
videos.overview: Dave and Emilie Beecroft love the bright colors, water and painted arches of Mexico, but have a backyard with a tiny deck and awkward spaces that make it a far cry from a resort destination. Mexico is brought to their backyard with the addition of a large concrete patio stamped to look like Mexican tile, a water feature with a Mexican clay pot and a fire pit lined with Mexican saltillo tiles. The old unsightly wooden deck gets a bright terracotta makeover and a wooden arch is painted to frame a new garden area and create the feel of a Mexican Resort Retreat right in the backyard.

videos.title: Tropical Paradise
videos.overview: This Fijian couple would love to have a taste of their homeland in their backyard, but not in its current state. Matt and crew repurpose dilapidated deck into a tropical thatched palapa, turn an uneven paver deck into a fresh looking space using interlocking pavers and add bamboo plants for privacy.

videos.title: Hillside Terrace
videos.overview: This first-time homeowner wants an entertainment space out of her existing bare hillside. What she gets is three 3 terraces cut into the hillside. Level one is off the master bedroom, accessed via a new glass door to take in the view and features "T" arbors framing the view of her new space. All three levels are connected by new decorative concrete steps. Level two features a hot tub and custom fire feature. Level three features a massive, ancient olive tree. The three terraces are ringed with retaining wall seating for 40! The new space is also warmed up with additional plantings of Redwood trees, Japanese Maples, and a Willow tree.

videos.title: Italian Villa Vista
videos.overview: A boring backyard is transformed from a non-usable space to a little piece of the Italian countryside with various areas to both entertain and to relax. The creation of a large elevated patio covered in pavers and an outdoor fireplace create a lounging area that provides a view reminiscent of the Italian countryside. The addition of large raised garden boxes and a multi-tiered fountain and benches create a strolling garden. With posts and wire framing a grapevine planting, a new stain on the existing patio and a handmade rustic wooden dining table, the yard becomes the perfect piece of Italy to use for entertaining.

videos.title: California Outdoor Room
videos.overview: This large backyard was empty except for a slab of concrete. Matt Blashaw and his crew totally transformed the space. A new outdoor kitchen wrapped in stone and topped with salvaged redwood, privacy walls using reclaimed farm wood, and a custom metal fire pit are just a few of the knock out designs. Surrounding the fire pit are custom-made campfire roasting forks. This large space transforms to an entertainment, eating and relaxing area for the whole family.

videos.title: The San Francisco Treat
videos.overview: A large backyard gets a Bocce Ball court, custom water feature and a grill station.

videos.title: Boston Backyard Theatre
videos.overview: A Boston couple who are big sports fans gets an outdoor theater for year round sports viewing parties. A previously bare backyard yard gets a new hardscape, seating wall and a fire feature made of stone.

videos.title: Play Ball
videos.overview: A large backyard gets a baseball batting cage with custom wooden bleachers and grill for hotdogs.

videos.title: Rustic Mexican Riviera
videos.overview: A nondescript yard is transformed into a rustic retreat with the addition of a large water feature.

videos.title: Upcycling the Backyard Space
videos.overview: An empty lot of a yard gets an upcycling makeover by Matt and his crew. They repurpose used materials to create a privacy wall and concrete pathway.

videos.title: Woodland Retreat
videos.overview: A backyard surrounded by woods gets a circular hardscape and a stone fire pit. A giant dogwood is planted next to custom furniture and a new table and benches are made of reclaimed white oak for an outdoor entertainment area.

videos.title: Cozy Cottage
